## 中文

**v0.5.15**

- Remote 支持原生自动化任务管理、插件配置与启停、DS Bot 卡片回复，以及创建缺失的工作区目录。
- 新增可选精简历史和 CodeX 工具详情按需加载；修复侧栏整行高亮与退出按钮对齐。
- Android 改进会话切换、流式显示、文件预览/下载及卡片刷新，新增五种语言，移除持久化对话正文预览。
- 修复插件安装入口，完善断线日志与使用文档。

感谢 @dreamfarer-space、@xiongyuyang、@tingfeng-droid、@zzalancelot、@luojiyin1987、@Sandwich-git、@rainow 和 @liguobao 的贡献！

## English

**v0.5.15**

- Support native automation task management, plugin configuration and enablement, DS Bot card replies, and missing workspace directory creation.
- Add optional compact history and on-demand CodeX tool details; fix full-row sidebar hover and right-aligned Exit.
- Improve Android session switching, streaming, file previews/downloads and card refresh; add five languages and remove persisted conversation previews.
- Fix plugin installation entry points and improve disconnect logs and documentation.

Thanks to @dreamfarer-space, @xiongyuyang, @tingfeng-droid, @zzalancelot, @luojiyin1987, @Sandwich-git, @rainow and @liguobao for their contributions!
